description:
[Official RDAP registry query. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Queries official ICANN and regional TLD RDAP endpoints to extract domain registration age (<30 days anti-phishing alert), registrar identity, DNSSEC cryptographic signing status, Autonomous System Number (ASN), and EU vs non-EU legal jurisdiction.
Usage: Use this tool to verify domain provenance, registrar identity, and anti-phishing domain age.
Returns: JSON object with { domain: string, registrationDate: string, domainAgeDays: number, isNewlyRegistered: boolean, registrar: string, dnssec: boolean, asn: number | null, jurisdiction: 'EU' | 'NON_EU', riskFlags: string[] }.

domain.description: Domain name to query on RDAP (e.g. novapixel.it)

name: domain_rdap_intel
title: Domain RDAP Intelligence & Phishing Flag
